_comment: OPTIONAL. A fresh clone boots to an empty board -- add agents with '+ Add agent' (pick a folder + CLI) instead of editing this. To declare a crew up front, copy this to fleet.local.json (git-ignored). 'lead' = the agent that answers un-@-addressed human messages (omit/empty = any agent may). 'crew' = agent NAMES only (each is its home folder's name, never a path or command); after seeding, set each one's folder + CLI in the Edit dialog (stored in data/roster.json). An agent's identity is its home folder's own CLAUDE.md -- nothing injected on top. To keep your crew file outside the repo, set FLEETCHAT_FLEET_FILE.
